verdict.rationale: Omnara is a managed-agent platform, so automated issue triage is a fair question for it. However, the evidence shows no documented feature that triages incoming issues, suggests severity, or routes them to an owner. Connecting a Linear MCP server, writing skills, and configuring event webhooks are developer building blocks a user could assemble into such a workflow, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have incoming issues automatically triaged with severity suggested and routed to the right owner
